ar.title: بطاطس ببورية

steps.n1: تسلق البطاطس بقشرها وبعد النضج تقشر وتهرس ساخنة جدا.
steps.n2: نحضر إناء ويوضع فيه اللبن مع الزبد أو السمن والملح والفلفل، ويترك حتى الغليان وترفع من الحرارة.
steps.n3: تضاف البطاطس المهروسة وتخلط جيدا مع السائل حتى تمتزج تماما، وتقدم ساخنة.

en.title: Batates Be Bourya (Mashed Potatoes)

steps.n1: Boil the potatoes in their skins; once cooked, peel them and mash them while they are still very hot.
steps.n2: In a saucepan, combine the milk, butter or ghee, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil, then remove from heat.
steps.n3: Add the mashed potatoes to the liquid and mix thoroughly until completely combined, then serve hot.

legacySteps: Boil the potatoes in their skins; once cooked, peel them and mash them while they are still very hot.
In a saucepan, combine the milk, butter or ghee, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil, then remove from heat.
Add the mashed potatoes to the liquid and mix thoroughly until completely combined, then serve hot.
